sentences.en: My friend says, "How old are you this year?"
I say, "I am twenty years old this year."
I also say, "How old are you this year?"
My friend says, "I am twenty-one years old this year."
She is older, I am younger, and we are both very happy.

quiz.q: How old is the narrator this year?
How old is the friend this year?
How do they feel at the end?

grammar.p: 今年多大 — how old are you this year
grammar.e: 今年 (this year) plus 多大 (how big/old) is a common way to ask an adult's age.
grammar.x: 你今年多大？ — How old are you this year?

grammar.p: 数字 + 岁 — number + years old
grammar.e: Put a number directly before 岁 to state an age; no verb is needed.
grammar.x: 我今年二十岁。 — I am twenty years old this year.

grammar.e: 大 and 小 can describe age directly, without a comparison word, when comparing two people already mentioned.
grammar.x: 她大，我小。 — She is older, I am younger.
